svg.desc: The input x is replicated on two GPUs. Each GPU multiplies by half of the first weight's columns and applies GELU locally, then by the matching half of the second weight's rows, producing a full-shape partial output. One all-reduce sums the partial outputs so both GPUs hold y.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Tensor parallelism: one MLP split across two GPUs

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Column-parallel first Linear, row-parallel second: one all-reduce per MLP.
